title: 선물 주고받기: 누구한테, 누구한테서?
objective: By the end, you can use 한테 for the person who gets something and 한테서 for the person something comes from. You will also know when to use 에 and when to use 에게 or 에게서 instead.
summary: Learn how to use 한테 (to someone) and 한테서 (from someone) when you talk about giving, sending, receiving and learning.

task.title: Use 한테 and 한테서
task.line: Read each item and choose, fill in, fix or write the correct form, using the rules on page 1.

forms.when: Use it after a person or an animal, with verbs like 주다, 보내다, 전화하다 and 말하다. It is the same after a final consonant (batchim) and after a vowel.
forms.means: to (someone): the person who gets the thing or the action
forms.exampleMeaning: I sent a photo to my younger sibling.

forms.when: Use it after a person, with verbs like 받다, 배우다 and 듣다. It is the same after a final consonant and after a vowel.
forms.means: from (someone): the person the thing comes from
forms.exampleMeaning: I got a watch from my dad.

forms.form: N + 한테 with 받다 / 배우다 / 듣다
forms.when: In everyday speech, Koreans often drop 서 with "getting" verbs like 받다, 배우다 and 듣다. It does not work with 주다 or 보내다.
forms.exampleMeaning: I learned swimming from my older brother.

forms.when: In writing, such as letters, emails and notices, use 에게 for 한테 and 에게서 for 한테서. The meaning is the same.
forms.exampleMeaning: I received an email from a friend.

watchOut: 학교한테 전화했어요 (X) → 학교에 전화했어요 (O): Use 한테 only for people and animals. For places and companies, use 에.
친구한테서 선물을 줬어요 (X) → 친구한테 선물을 줬어요 (O): With 주다, 보내다 and 전화하다, the action goes to the person, so use 한테, not 한테서.
친구한테 만났어요 (X) → 친구를 만났어요 (O): 만나다 takes 을/를, not 한테.
exercises: Choose the correct particle. If both are correct, write both: ① 저는 매일 고양이(한테 / 한테서) 밥을 줘요. ② 생일에 할머니(한테 / 한테서) 돈을 받았어요. ③ 어제 친구(한테 / 한테서) 메시지를 보냈어요.
Fill in the blank with 한테 or 에: ① 아침에 우체국____ 전화했어요. ② 저녁에 누나____ 전화했어요.
Find the mistake and write the correct sentence: 주말에 언니한테 만났어요.
Your friend 지민 gave you a book. Choose the correct sentence: (a) 지민 씨한테서 책을 줬어요. (b) 지민 씨한테서 책을 받았어요. (c) 지민 씨를 책을 받았어요.
Answer in Korean using 한테서. The bag came from your older sister (언니): 그 가방, 누구한테서 받았어요?
Rewrite this sentence for a diary or written report. Change only the particle: 친구한테 이메일을 보냈어요.
answers: ① 한테 ② 한테서 (한테 is also correct) ③ 한테
주말에 언니를 만났어요. (주말에 언니하고 만났어요. is also correct.)
